summarizes SELL rationales.

Visual identity extracted from the company's annual report cover.

All optional — report_formatter falls back to a neutral Finance X palette
if nothing is supplied.

cbam_default_intensity.description: Default tCO2/ton product assumed by EU if unverified.
cbam_default_intensity.title: Cbam Default Intensity

sector.description: One of: holding, steel, refinery, banking, telecom, aviation, retail, defense, energy, other.

final_summary, report_formatter.

EngineRatios.description: All derived ratios. None means not computable with the given inputs.
EngineRatios.title: EngineRatios

EquityChange.description: Statement of changes in equity — summary, not full rollforward.

EsgData.title: EsgData

One KAP disclosure. Minimal required fields; rich optional ones.

Required: disclosure_id, ticker, announced_at, title, url.

disclosure_id.title: Disclosure Id

KapEvent.title: KapEvent

MacroSnapshot.description:
Macro variables on a given date. All optional — macro is a supplement,
not a blocker.
MacroSnapshot.title: MacroSnapshot

history.description: Most-recent-first or ordered; technical_analysis handles sort.
history.title: History

MetaInfo.description:
Identifies a TickerPackage and tracks its provenance.

Required: ticker, package_date, schema_version, producer.
Optional: sources list, producer_version, notes.

package_date.description: Reporting date the package represents (not build time).
package_date.title: Package Date

producer.description: Python module that built this package, e.g. 'financex.crawlers.kchol'.
producer.title: Producer

sources.description: Canonical sources consulted (not exhaustive — line-level SourceRef lives on the data).
sources.title: Sources

ticker.description: BIST ticker in uppercase, e.g. 'KCHOL', 'THYAO'. Minimum 3 characters.
ticker.title: Ticker

MetaInfo.title: MetaInfo

PeriodFinancials.description: Four statements bundled for one reporting period.

ias29_restated.description: True if figures are inflation-adjusted under IAS 29 (Turkish high-inflation accounting).
ias29_restated.title: Ias29 Restated

PeriodFinancials.title: PeriodFinancials

QualityControl.description:
Aggregated health of a TickerPackage.

- `missing_fields` lists optional-but-critical fields that came back null.
- `flags` lists producer-surfaced issues.
- `overall_score` is a 0-1 heuristic (1 = perfect, <0.5 = downstream may downgrade).

degraded.description: Set True when a soft-block trip occurs — downstream should know the pipeline is limping.
degraded.title: Degraded

QualityControl.title: QualityControl

QualityFlag.description: A single non-fatal issue flagged by a producer.
QualityFlag.title: QualityFlag

RatioValue.description: One ratio with value and optional warning (mirrors TS engine pattern).
RatioValue.title: RatioValue

SourceRef.description: Provenance pointer — every material datum must cite at least one.

detail.description: e.g. KAP disclosure ID, PDF page number, API endpoint.
detail.title: Detail

SourceRef.title: SourceRef

market_value_try.description: Fair value of the stake in TRY, if computable.
market_value_try.title: Market Value Try

ticker.description: If listed; null for private subsidiaries.
ticker.title: Ticker

TechnicalIndicators.description:
All fields Optional — a package is valid even without technicals.

from `MarketData.history` using the `ta` library.

Company-specific sensitivity translated from macro moves.

Python computes the arithmetic; the LLM later adds narrative.

fx_sensitivity_annual_try.title: Fx Sensitivity Annual Try

description:
The full bundle produced by the Python data layer.

Required vs Optional here encodes the hybrid doctrine:
  Required = without this, the LLM reasoning layer has no floor to stand on.
  Optional = missing is annoying, not fatal — flagged in `quality.missing_fields`.
title: TickerPackage
